title: [Bug] GEPA reflection_minibatch_size parameter ignored, causing context length explosions
author: Ju-usc

comments.author: TomeHirata
comments.body: The `reflection_minibatch_size` argument is passed to `gepa.optimize` and should be handled by the gepa library. @LakshyAAAgrawal Can you double-confirm the behavior?

comments.author: LakshyAAAgrawal
Ju-usc
comments.body: My bad—I misunderstood how this works. I was only looking at the DSPy codebase and didn't check the GEPA library code. The real issue is that ReAct trajectories are huge (full conversation history + multiple LM calls), not that the minibatch size is ignored. Sorry for the confusion. Feel free to close!
